Everything in reach

Fast on big vaults

Plain Markdown. Standard Git. Works everywhere.

Your notes shouldn't be trapped in an app. Nothing here is proprietary — leave anytime, take everything.

Plain Markdown

Ordinary .md files in ordinary folders. Open your vault in any editor, run any script, keep backups — the app earns its place every day.

Standard Git

One normal git repository per vault. Any remote you own, any host. Non-overlapping edits merge line by line; conflicts are preserved, never overwritten.

Honest metadata

SQLite only accelerates search and sync — it can be rebuilt from the files at any time. The files are the truth, the index is a cache.

your notes outlive the app — that's the design, not a promise
